text: Toll Services: Your vehicle has an unpaid toll balance of $6.99. To avoid a $50 late fee, pay by today: https://tollpay-renew.top/us

result.headline: This is a scam. Real toll agencies don't text links asking you to pay right away.

red_flags.why: The link goes to 'tollpay-renew.top', not your state's real toll website.

what_to_do: Don't tap the link or reply.
if_already_acted: Call the number on the back of your card.
result.family_message: Texts saying you owe a toll are scams. Don't tap them!

text: Hi, is this Mark? We met at the conference last month. I wanted to share the trading app I told you about, it's been amazing for me.

result.headline: Be careful. This looks like the start of a crypto investment scam.

red_flags.flag: Stranger who seems to know you

red_flags.why: Investment talk from a stranger is a common scam path.

safe_signs: No link or payment request yet.
what_to_do: Don't reply or download any app.
if_already_acted: Don't send money. Talk to someone you trust.
result.family_message: If a stranger texts about a great trading app, it's probably a scam.

text: Your Bank: Your verification code is 482913. We will never call you to ask for this code.

result.headline: This looks like a normal code you asked for. Just don't share it.
safe_signs: You requested it a moment ago.
No link or phone number to call.
what_to_do: Type the code into the app yourself.
Never read it to anyone who calls.
if_already_acted: If you shared the code, change your password now.
result.family_message: Real code texts say 'don't share this'. Never read a code to a caller.

text: SecureShield: Your subscription auto-renewed for $399.99. Didn't authorize? Call our refund desk 1-888-555-0143 within 24 hours.

result.headline: This is a scam. It wants you to call a fake 'refund desk.'

red_flags.why: The 'refund desk' is run by scammers who ask for remote access.

if_already_acted: If you let them into your computer, disconnect it from the internet.
result.family_message: Emails about a $399 renewal with a number to call are scams.
